canon_requests.old: Destructible blocks are doors, crates, barrels, cracked walls that hide secrets, wooden structures, glass, ice, webs, light fixtures, rubble, pit lids, hull panels and every Errata placeable; no structural wall or floor is destructible.
canon_requests.new: Destructible blocks are doors, crates, barrels and powder kegs, furniture, cracked walls that hide secrets, wooden structures, glass, ice, webs, plants, light fixtures, light switches and fuse boxes, rubble, pit lids, hull panels, doc 08 reaction products, resource nodes, conjured walls, gadget barriers and every Errata placeable; no structural wall or floor is destructible.
canon_requests.why: Doc 07 §10.1 tags block.leaves, block.tall_grass, block.vine, block.obsidian, block.basalt, block.slag, block.wardrobe, block.bed, block.table, block.light_switch, block.fuse_box, the 23 block.node.*, block.conjured, block.cover.barrier and block.powder_keg destructible because clearing, harvesting, burning or breaking them is their purpose; Canon §4.3 does not list them (doc 07 Canon gaps item 1; block.crop dropped from the plant list by DECISIONS 128).

canon_requests.old: Destruction removes micro-voxels, not whole cells. Damage to a destructible cell (block.tag.destructible, §4.3) removes micro-voxels inside the damage volume, nearest the impact first, at 250 mm granularity. A cell whose mask reaches 0 becomes air.
canon_requests.new: Append: "A destructible cell whose shape occupies no micro-voxels or whose mask follows its props breaks whole at 0 block HP (doc 07 §10.8)."
canon_requests.why: Ladder, cross and fixture shapes occupy no micro-voxels, and door, trapdoor, fence and pane masks change with their props, so doc 07 §10.8 (with doc 03 §13.2) lets these shapes and resource nodes keep their mask and break whole when block HP reaches 0 (doc 07 Canon gaps item 2).

canon_requests.section: Canon §5.8 Local genre and personal VERVE
canon_requests.old: local_genre(pos) is the genre of the bleed zone containing block fx_floor_block(pos), or the Folio's genre outside bleed zones. Doc 12 defines bleed zones. … Inside a seam zone, local_genre(pos) is the Folio's genre …
canon_requests.new: Add a bullet: "**Fused Folios.** In a Second Edition Folio written in two fused genres (DECISIONS.md item 101), doc 12 assigns each zone one genre of the pair; `local_genre(pos)` is the genre of the zone containing `fx_floor_block(pos)`, and `local_axiom(pos, a)` is `floor_div(x + y, 2)` of the pair's two values of `a`."
canon_requests.why: A Second Edition Folio has two genres, so 'the Folio's genre' names two; doc 07 §1.5 reads one genre per position for origin_genre, station skins, vein weights, the genre stone/wood/salvage pair, butchery salvage and genre legality (doc 07 Canon gaps item 3; DECISIONS 101 says axioms are averaged).

product_questions.question: mat.role.block has no consumer: no rule, recipe or validator reads it, and eight masonry materials (titanium, coral, dreamstuff, paper, vellum, birch, thornwood, blackwood) lack it although they form block.masonry.* blocks. Should the role gate which materials may form blocks, be dropped, or stay informational?
product_questions.default_applied: Informational (doc 07 §2.4 sentence: 'mat.role.block is informational: no rule, recipe or validator reads it, and a block record may name any §2.2 material whether or not it carries bk').
options: Keep it informational (applied): no gate, no content change.
Make it a gate: a block record may name only materials carrying bk; add bk to the eight masonry materials in §2.2.
Drop the role: 9 roles become 8; §2.2 roles column, Exports and test 51 change.

product_questions.question: The §2.5 formula gives block.cover.sandbag blast_res_milli 1000 (block.cover.plate 5500), while doc 03's former sample record said 3500. Should sandbags be explosion cover with an override in §10.1?

options: Keep 1000 (applied): sandbags stop bullets (cover) and chip under blasts like any sand block.
Override to 3500 in §10.1 so sandbags are explosion cover, matching doc 03's old sample.
Override to another value the product owner names.
